Container.Name: Book-Embedding
Container.Overview: High-Dimensional Book Embedding & Similarity Discovery Engine. Optimized for Intel 12th Gen CPUs using AVX2/VNNI vector acceleration. Features 2D UMAP Galaxy Constellations, dynamic stylistic importance tuning, and instant typo-tolerant catalog search.
Container.Description: High-Dimensional Book Embedding & Similarity Discovery Engine. Optimized for Intel 12th Gen CPUs using AVX2/VNNI vector acceleration.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Book Embedding Web UI (e.g. 8000, 8080, 8501).

Config.Name: App Data Path
Config.Description: Container path for catalog metadata, embeddings, and vector indices.

Config.Name: Model Cache
Config.Description: Persistent model cache path so HuggingFace models persist across container updates.

Config.Name: Compute Device
Config.Description: Compute backend (cpu for Intel 12th Gen i5, cuda if passing an NVIDIA GPU).

Config.Name: Container Port Env
Config.Description: Internal container port bound by Uvicorn.

Config.Name: Intel OpenMP Threads
Config.Description: Number of CPU threads allocated for parallel vector math.
